summary.text: Tom Gann is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 8 and has served since the 56th Legislature. His House biography describes him as a former chairman of the Administrative Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gann was born in Wagoner and grew up in Tahlequah, where he later graduated from Northeastern State University with degrees in marketing and accounting.
In 1984 he started a small business in Ft. Gibson selling gas and groceries, which he sold in 1996, and he later developed other commercial properties.
He served five years on the Ft. Gibson School Board and has served as a Republican State Committeeman and a member of the Republican Party’s Platform Committee.

In 2018 Gann served on the House Special Investigative Committee that examined the Oklahoma Department of Health, and in 2019 he co-authored Senate Bill 316 with Sen. Nathan Dahm on agency transparency, which became law on November 1, 2019.
He is retired from serving as the Airports Auditor for the Tulsa International Airport.
Gann and his wife have been married 46 years and have three children and eight grandchildren.
The family attends church in the Inola area.
